newsitem.title: USA: Minn gov expected to veto plan for elected council.
newsitem.headline: Minn gov expected to veto plan for elected council.

text.p: Minnesota legislators have approved a plan to make the Metropolitan Council an elective body, but Gov. Arne Carlson is expected to veto the legislation when it lands on his desk, spokesman Brian Dietz said Tuesday.

The governor-appointed 17-member council reviews and approves major capital projects and issues debt for transit operations, wastewater services, regional parks, airports and sports facilities in the Minneapolis-St. Paul metropolitan area.

Minnesota senators voted 36-30 Monday to pass a bill earlier approved by representatives to make the council an elective body. Lawmakers had failed to move a proposal through the legislature in past sessions.
